en: A color postcard showing a snowy winter scene of a grand historic square. In the foreground stands a chimney sweep carrying ladders. To the right is a large neo‑Renaissance city hall building with a central dome and towers, fronted by a fountain and market stalls covered in snow. The left side shows old townhouses with colorful shutters along a street. Yellow German text at the top reads a New Year greeting from Graz, and a caption at the bottom names the location as the main square and Herrengasse.
